paragraphs: Ben Kupya. Once the government decreed that R' Yehudah the baker should be killed. What did ben Kupya do? He made himself a judge and tried that man. When he came to deliver his sentence, he decreed that another should be slaughtered in his place, cut into pieces, and brought up. A slanderer ran and said that he had not been killed. The government decreed that ben Kupya should be killed; both were killed. The Holy One, blessed be He, will in the future demand their blood: Yalkut on Psalms 9 (remez 643:9).
